title: Extract WFC Plugin
description: Extract wave function collapse from the procedural plugin (assembly artifact wfc-engine inference) into its own `✏️s/🔌️plugins/🌊️wfc` plugin with five artifacts: bitmap (overlapping-model input/output bitmap editor), 2d-grid (regular rectangular grid, fixed left/right/top/bottom neighbours, vector/bitmap tiles, grid canvas + 2d preview), 2d (arbitrary-neighbour graph, non-rectangular shape, graph-with-slots editor + 2d preview), 3d-grid (regular non-uniform box grid, six fixed neighbours, mesh tiles, grid box + 3d preview), 3d (arbitrary-neighbour graph, mesh tiles, graph-with-slots editor + 3d preview).
